name: System One
description: Typed decision provider for any System One server (Kev, llama.cpp router and others) with a configurable base URL, model label and API key.

baseUrl.label: System One server
baseUrl.help: Origin of the server, such as http://127.0.0.1:8009 or http://10.0.0.5:8080. The plugin appends /v1/systemone. No path, query or credentials.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.help: Optional. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Prefer a SecretRef in Settings → Secrets. Use https when the server is not on this machine.

model.label: Model label
model.help: Sent as the System One model for systemone/default, for example clef-flash on a llama.cpp router. Leave empty for single-model servers such as Kev.

timeoutMs.label: Request timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.help: 1,000 to 30,000. OpenClaw allows each decision at most 30 seconds.
